source_text: Hasty generalization, slippery slope, false dilemma, appeal to the people, and guilt by association are pilot-only. Appeal to the people is the catalog id (appeal to popularity is an alias). Guilt by association is split from ad hominem: do not edit ad hominem atoms or forbids, and do not require attacks_person for an association used as the sole support of an evaluative conclusion.
